question: Which great mantra is identified as the essential heart of Svacchandabhairava?
premises: A great mantra is being identified.
It is the heart of Svacchandabhairava.
It is formed as the essence.
inference: The great mantra is the essential heart of Svacchandabhairava.
plain_english: It is the heart of Svacchandabhairava, the great mantra that is the very essence.
